configured_note: Models already serving this GGUF, and how they differ from the plan. Values the plan read out of the file are facts; the rest are defaults a deliberate variant (a CPU-only twin, a short-context twin) may be overriding on purpose — so this is a proposal to review, not a correction to apply blindly. The one exception is 'unset', which lists configuration the file provably cannot support.
next_step: pass these to lmgw__local_model_set action=create (adding model_id), then lmgw__container target=chat action=apply, then lmgw__local_model_test

rationale.cache_type_k: halves KV cache versus the f16 default, at negligible quality cost
rationale.cache_type_v: halves KV cache versus the f16 default, at negligible quality cost
rationale.ctx_size: the model's trained context (131072) — its real ceiling, not a reduced default
rationale.gguf_path: the file this plan was made for
rationale.jinja: the GGUF embeds a chat template; without --jinja it is ignored and tool calling will not work
rationale.mmproj_path: sibling projector (gemma4uv), so the model can accept images
rationale.spec_draft_n_max: the drafter's block size is 8 (dflash.block_size); llama.cpp drafts at most block_size − 1 = 7 tokens per step
rationale.spec_type: dictated by the drafter's architecture ('dflash') — a mismatched spec_type fails at load
rationale.ubatch_size: llama.cpp decodes this gemma4uv projector's images with non-causal attention, so a whole image has to fit in one physical batch, and at llama.cpp's default of 512 a larger image aborts the server with GGML_ASSERT "non-causal attention requires n_ubatch >= n_tokens". The projector's largest image sets the number: Gemma 4 images stop at about 1100 tokens (its largest budget is 1120), and this adds a margin. No higher, because every ubatch token costs compute buffer in VRAM. The default batch_size (2048) already covers it
